acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /api/projects/:slug/dialogues returns JSON array of { filename, stage, wp_id } for all .md files in {slug}/dialogues/
GET /api/projects/:slug/dialogues?wp=WP-001 filters results to WP-001 prefix
GET /api/projects/:slug/dialogues/:filename returns the raw Markdown content
handleGetDialogueFile rejects filenames containing '..', '/', or '\' with HTTP 400
handleGetDialogueFile rejects filenames not matching the safe pattern (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, .md only)
slug is validated with assertSafeSlug() before any file access
Returns HTTP 404 when dialogue file does not exist
Returns HTTP 404 when dialogues/ directory does not exist (no files yet)
Unit tests cover listing, filtering, content serving, and path traversal rejection
